name: SuggestedPostPrice
description: Describes the price of a suggested post.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Currency in which the post will be paid. Currently, must be one of “XTR” for Telegram Stars or “TON” for TON grams.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: The amount of the currency that will be paid for the post in the _smallest units_ of the currency, i.e. Telegram Stars or nanograms. Currently, price in Telegram Stars must be between 5 and 100000, and price in nanograms must be between 10000000 and 10000000000000.
